primary_hypothesis: Short contracts with feasible prefixes, real prerequisites, deadlines and observable receipts reduce avoidable crop/animal losses without weakening whole-game realized production.
execution_changes_in_scope: persistent target and exact receipt confirmation
target-bound resupply instead of blind pickup
maintenance deadline tied to actual EOD
ordinary product return runs only when no contract is assigned
preidentified_risks: one-unit feed pickup may increase resupply distance and actions
persistent work may delay cargo return and increase EOD overflow
production changes alter natural RNG shop sequences
workflow: Freeze candidate manifest first; opened diagnostic is for attribution and not promotion. Then execute all fresh 3x2 pairs against both frozen R0 and R3, retain every game including errors. Any fail retires this candidate; no same-SHA retuning. If screening survives, allocate new G1/G2 blocks per protocol.
freshness_check: No current evaluation/games.jsonl uses any 5401..5403 seed; exact run manifests checked again at candidate freeze.
